title: 環繞閘極奈米片電晶體
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 奈米片堆疊
stages.description: 在「奈米片堆疊」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for nanosheet stacks, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 環繞閘拓撲
steps.objective: 完成「環繞閘拓撲」的因果圖，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for draw the gate-all-around topology, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：環繞閘拓撲。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：閘須包覆通道四周而非只有上表面。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Draw the gate-all-around topology. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: The gate surrounds the channel rather than covering only its top. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「閘須包覆通道四周而非只有上表面。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: The gate surrounds the channel rather than covering only its top. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「環繞閘拓撲」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw the gate-all-around topology and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「環繞閘拓撲」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for draw the gate-all-around topology: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 環繞閘拓撲的原理
knowledge.text: 閘須包覆通道四周而非只有上表面。
knowledge.textEn: The gate surrounds the channel rather than covering only its top.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 奈米片有效通道寬與片周長及片數相關，但片間空間同時限制閘金屬體積。
knowledge.textEn: Effective channel width relates to sheet perimeter and count, while inter-sheet spacing limits gate-metal volume.

quiz.question: 評估「環繞閘拓撲」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating draw the gate-all-around topology?
options: 閘須包覆通道四周而非只有上表面。
總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。
頂面膜厚代表所有側壁與底部厚度。
optionsEn: The gate surrounds the channel rather than covering only its top.
Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact.
Top thickness represents all sidewall and bottom thicknesses.
quiz.explanation: 閘須包覆通道四周而非只有上表面。 奈米片有效通道寬與片周長及片數相關，但片間空間同時限制閘金屬體積。
quiz.explanationEn: The gate surrounds the channel rather than covering only its top. Effective channel width relates to sheet perimeter and count, while inter-sheet spacing limits gate-metal volume.

steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Assign stack-layer roles. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Channel layers and removable sacrificial layers need separate labels. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「通道層與可移除犧牲層需分開標示。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「堆疊層角色」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for assign stack-layer roles: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 片寬與驅動
steps.objective: 完成「片寬與驅動」的敏感度草圖，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for relate sheet width and drive, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：片寬與驅動。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：較寬通道增加驅動但也改變電容與機械穩定。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Relate sheet width and drive. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Wider sheets change drive, capacitance and mechanical stability. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「較寬通道增加驅動但也改變電容與機械穩定。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.check: 交付「片寬與驅動」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for relate sheet width and drive: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.title: 層間距預算
steps.objective: 完成「層間距預算」的故障判別表，把片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for budget inter-sheet spacing, connecting relevant limits in inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：層間距預算。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：間距需容納介電、功函數及閘金屬。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。 自訂間隙預算：片間距 20 個單位，兩側各需介電 2、功函數層 3；算中間剩餘填充空間，再讓每側功函數層各增加 1 單位檢查裕度。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Budget inter-sheet spacing. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Spacing must fit dielectric, work-function and gate metal. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs. Hypothetical gap budget: spacing 20 units, each face needs dielectric 2 and work-function metal 3. Calculate remaining fill space and test margin after increasing each face’s work-function layer by 1 unit.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「間距需容納介電、功函數及閘金屬。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Spacing must fit dielectric, work-function and gate metal. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「層間距預算」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for budget inter-sheet spacing and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「層間距預算」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。 同時交付算例的中間步驟或比較圖，並標示假設與模型限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for budget inter-sheet spacing: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order. Also submit intermediate calculations or comparison diagrams with assumptions and model limits.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：底部隔離。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：底部寄生通道不能因上層環繞閘而自動消失。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define bottom isolation. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: Bottom parasitic conduction does not vanish merely because upper sheets are gated. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.

Interpretation: Layer-thickness variation can create electrically different channels. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
